task: Predict KRAS mutation status in lung adenocarcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, focus on architectural and cytologic differences such as mucinous differentiation, gland formation, solid growth, necrosis, and inflammatory background.

classes.0: KRAS-negative lung adenocarcinoma lacking the strongest morphology associated with KRAS-driven tumors, often with less mucinous differentiation.
classes.1: KRAS-positive lung adenocarcinoma showing features that may include mucinous change, invasive glandular or solid growth, and more aggressive cytologic atypia.
